## Company Overview

Signhify is an MSME-registered (UDYAM-UP-30-0081308) AI engineering studio headquartered in Noida, India. It functions as an AI-powered product studio — clients describe their idea in plain English, and Signhify's autonomous 6-agent AI swarm designs, engineers, tests, secures, and deploys production-ready software. Delivery is guaranteed in 2-week sprints. Clients receive 100% source code ownership via full GitHub repository transfer with zero platform lock-in.

Founded in 2024 by Piyush Raj Singh, Signhify has shipped 20+ production SaaS products across AI, EdTech, CRM, and digital marketing verticals.

---

## Mission & Vision

**Mission**: Make production-grade software accessible to anyone with an idea — no technical co-founder required, no 6-month dev timeline, no six-figure budget.

**Vision (2026–2030)**:
- **2026**: Establish Signhify as the default AI engineering studio for founders and SMBs
- **2027**: Launch Signhify Cloud — managed hosting, monitoring, and auto-scaling for all studio-built products
- **2028**: Signhify Marketplace matures into an independent app ecosystem with third-party developer payouts
- **2029**: Signhify Agents — deployable AI agents that operate autonomously within client stacks
- **2030**: Full ecosystem: studio + cloud + marketplace + agents = end-to-end AI-native product infrastructure

## Detailed Service Descriptions

### 1. AI Automation
Custom automation pipelines using AI agents. Includes workflow automation, RPA integration, LLM-based decision engines, and multi-step agent chains. Signhify builds automation that connects your tools, processes data, and executes actions without human intervention.

### 2. SaaS Development
Full-stack subscription platform development. Every SaaS includes authentication (Google/GitHub OAuth), database (Supabase PostgreSQL), payments (Stripe subscriptions), admin dashboard, analytics, and email automation. Deployed on Cloudflare with CI/CD.

### 3. Web & Product Design
Conversion-optimized UI/UX design. Services include wireframing, high-fidelity mockups, design systems, component libraries, and brand-aligned visual design. All designs are engineered for performance (Core Web Vitals) and accessibility (WCAG).

### 4. CRM Systems
Custom CRM platforms with pipeline management, contact scoring, email sequencing, task automation, and reporting. Built on Supabase with optional AI-powered lead scoring and follow-up automation.

### 5. Digital & Performance Marketing
End-to-end marketing execution: paid ad campaigns (Google, Meta, LinkedIn), SEO optimization, conversion rate optimization (CRO), email marketing automation, funnel design, and attribution modeling. AI-powered campaign optimization.

### 6. Brand Identity
Complete branding packages: logo design, color palette, typography system, brand guidelines, social media templates, and brand strategy documentation.

### 7. API Engineering
RESTful and GraphQL API design, development, and documentation. Third-party integrations, webhook systems, rate limiting, authentication (JWT, API keys), and API monitoring.

### 8. Cloud & DevOps
Infrastructure setup on Cloudflare, AWS, or self-hosted. CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), Docker containerization, monitoring (Sentry), logging, auto-scaling, and disaster recovery planning.

### 9. Data & Analytics
Custom dashboards, real-time analytics, data pipelines, ETL processes, business intelligence systems, and custom reporting. Built with Recharts, Supabase, and optional AI-powered insights.

### 10. Mobile App Development
Responsive web applications that work as PWAs. Mobile-first design, touch-optimized interactions, offline support, and app-like navigation. Built with React and deployed via Cloudflare.

### 11. Security & Compliance
BYOK AES-256 GCM encryption vault, audit logging, SOC2 readiness assessments, GDPR compliance checks, rate limiting, input sanitization, and security audit reports.

### 12. AI & LLM Integrations
Custom GPT development, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, model fine-tuning (Claude, GPT, open-source), AI agent orchestration, and LLM gateway implementation with auto-fallback.

---

## Founder Story

Piyush Raj Singh founded Signhify after years of building software products and noticing a pattern: most founders with great ideas couldn't find technical co-founders, and most agencies delivered over-engineered solutions on slow timelines.

He built Signhify's first agent swarm to automate the repetitive parts of full-stack development — schema design, boilerplate generation, testing — while keeping human oversight on architecture and business logic. The result was a studio that could ship a production SaaS in 2 weeks instead of 2 months.

Today, Signhify operates as both a service studio (building client products) and a platform (templates, marketplace, cloud deployment), with a remote team spanning India and serving clients globally.

## Technology Stack (Detailed)

### Frontend
- **Framework**: React 19 + TanStack Start (SSR, file-based routing, server functions)
- **Build**: Vite 6 + Nitro (edge worker bundling, Cloudflare adapter)
- **Styling**: TailwindCSS 4 + class-variance-authority + tailwind-merge
- **Animation**: Framer Motion 12, Three.js + @react-three/fiber/drei
- **UI Components**: Radix UI primitives (accordion, dialog, dropdown, popover, select, tabs, tooltip, etc.)
- **Icons**: Lucide React
- **Forms**: React Hook Form + Zod + @hookform/resolvers
- **Charts**: Recharts
- **Carousel**: Embla Carousel
- **Date Handling**: date-fns
- **Toast**: sonner

### Backend & Data
- **Server Functions**: TanStack Server Functions (file-based .functions.ts, RPC-like)
- **Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL 15) with Row-Level Security
- **Auth**: Supabase Auth (Google, GitHub OAuth, magic links, RLS policies)
- **ORM**: Prisma 7
- **Caching**: Cloudflare KV (planned)

### AI Pipeline
- **Primary Models**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Anthropic), GPT-4o (OpenAI)
- **Gateway**: Custom resilient gateway with auto-fallback between providers
- **Agent Architecture**: 6-agent pipeline (schema architect → UX designer → code builder → test runner → security auditor → deployer)
- **Encryption**: BYOK AES-256 GCM vault (client-side Web Crypto API, zero server-side key access)
- **Context Window**: Handle up to 200K tokens per agent session
- **Rate Limiting**: Configurable per-agent, per-provider

### Infrastructure
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Workers + Cloudflare Pages
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions (lint → test → build → deploy)
- **DNS**: Cloudflare (custom domain: signhify.dpdns.org)
- **Monitoring**: Sentry (Node.js error tracking, performance monitoring)
- **CDN**: Cloudflare global edge network

### Payments
- **Primary**: Stripe (Checkout, subscriptions, usage-based metering, marketplace payouts)
- **India**: Razorpay (domestic payments)
- **Wallet**: PayPal
- **UPI**: 6202442690@jio

## Pricing Philosophy

Signhify operates on three principles:
1. **Fixed-price sprints** — clients know the cost upfront, no hourly billing surprises
2. **Value over hours** — a Sprint isn't 2 weeks of work, it's a shipped outcome
3. **Zero lock-in** — code belongs to the client, always

The Sprint tier ($299) is designed as a risk-free entry point: a full production MVP delivered in 5-7 days. Most clients start here, validate product-market fit, then upgrade to Studio ($799/mo) for ongoing execution.

Studio clients get a dedicated team — product manager, designer, engineer — with weekly releases. Platform (custom) is for enterprise clients needing multi-app architectures, custom LLM fine-tuning, or SOC2 compliance.

### When to choose each:

**Choose Signhify when**: You need a shipped product, not generated code. You don't have a technical team. You want auth, payments, and deployment wired. You're a founder who wants to focus on customers, not infrastructure.

**Choose Cursor when**: You're an experienced developer who wants AI-assisted daily coding. You already have infrastructure and deployment pipelines.

**Choose Lovable when**: You want to quickly prototype an idea yourself and have some technical ability. You're okay with platform-dependent hosting.

**Choose v0 when**: You need UI inspiration or component prototypes. You're comfortable integrating generated code into an existing project.

**Choose Bolt when**: You want an AI-assisted full-stack builder and are comfortable with Vercel's ecosystem. You have time to tweak and debug.

**Choose Replit when**: You want an online IDE with collaboration features. You're building small to medium projects.

## FAQ (Extended)

**Q: What is the AI Blueprint Generator?**
A: A free tool at https://signhify.dpdns.org/ai that takes a plain-English product description and returns a complete architecture blueprint — database schema, API routes, UI component tree, authentication rules, and pricing model — in approximately 90 seconds.

**Q: How does the 6-agent swarm work?**
A: Each product request is processed by six specialized AI agents in sequence: (1) Schema Architect designs the data model, (2) UX Designer creates the interface, (3) Code Builder generates the full-stack implementation, (4) Test Runner validates functionality, (5) Security Auditor checks for vulnerabilities, and (6) Deployer pushes to production. Human engineers review every stage.

**Q: What is BYOK encryption and why does it matter?**
A: BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) means you provide your own API keys for AI and payment services. These keys are encrypted client-side using AES-256 GCM (via the Web Crypto API) before being stored. The Signhify server never has access to the raw keys — only your browser can decrypt them. This eliminates the risk of server-side key leakage.

**Q: Can I migrate away from Signhify after launch?**
A: Yes, and we encourage it. Every engagement includes full GitHub repository transfer with all code, configuration, and documentation. You can deploy the same codebase to any provider — Vercel, AWS, Netlify, your own server. There is zero platform dependency.

**Q: What happens if the project scope changes mid-sprint?**
A: Sprint is fixed-scope by design. If scope changes, we complete the Sprint as planned and start a new Sprint for the additional work. Studio and Platform engagements have more flexibility with rolling scope.

**Q: Do you offer maintenance after launch?**
A: Studio engagements include 30 days of post-launch support. Separate maintenance retainers are available for ongoing updates, bug fixes, and feature additions. There is no obligation — you own the code and can maintain it yourself or hire any developer.

**Q: What industries do you work with?**
A: SaaS, EdTech, FinTech, HealthTech, E-commerce, Real Estate, Marketing, Logistics, and more. The stack is adaptable to any industry that needs web-based software.

**Q: Can Signhify integrate with existing systems?**
A: Yes. We regularly integrate with existing databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB), third-party APIs (Stripe, Twilio, SendGrid, OpenAI, etc.), and legacy systems. API Engineering is one of our 12 core capabilities.

**Q: What is the Signhify Marketplace?**
A: A platform for independent builders and creators to list and sell templates, components, AI agent workflows, and full-stack applications. Transactions are processed via Stripe with automated payouts.

**Q: How long does a Studio engagement typically last?**
A: Most Studio clients stay for 3-6 months to build and iterate on their product, then transition to maintenance. Some continue indefinitely with ongoing feature development.
